description: A team is bringing on a new vendor and must gather security forms, billing setup details, service contacts, escalation paths, and scope documents so the relationship starts with usable records. All company names are fictional.

user_profile.persona: 37-year-old procurement coordinator responsible for making new vendors operational
user_profile.context: The contract is signed, but the practical setup work is still fragmented across teams
user_profile.communication_style: Process-driven and tidy, likes complete onboarding packets

user_needs.description: What is the vendor's legal name and primary business address?
What is the contract number and what is the name of the service being provided?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After identifying the vendor, the user will want to reference the specific contract and service.

user_needs.description: What is the contract start date and its initial term length?
What is the title of the governing Statement of Work document?
Which security compliance documents, like the SOC 2 report and security questionnaire, do we have on file?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After confirming contract terms, verifying the vendor's security posture via their compliance documents is a critical next step for a procurement coordinator.

user_needs.description: What is the vendor's Tax ID number and the monthly recurring cost?
What are the payment terms and which email address should invoices be sent to?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: Once the cost is known, the next logical questions are about how and where to pay.

user_needs.description: Who is the billing contact at QuantumLeap Analytics?
Who is our primary relationship manager and the assigned Technical Account Manager?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: With billing contacts established, the next logical step is to identify the primary relationship and technical contacts for the service itself.

user_needs.description: What is the general support email address and the URL for the support portal?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After identifying named contacts, the user will want the general, process-based support channels.

user_needs.description: Who are the first and second level escalation contacts for service issues?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After getting standard support channels, a process-driven coordinator will want to know the formal escalation path for unresolved issues.

user_needs.description: Is there a 24/7 emergency support number for critical outages?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: Following the standard escalation path, the user would want to know the contact for the most critical, emergency situations.

user_needs.description: What is the primary API endpoint for the InsightEngine platform?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After identifying the primary relationship manager and the assigned Technical Account Manager, a process-driven onboarding coordinator would naturally gather the core implementation detail the technical team will need next, namely the primary API endpoint for the InsightEngine platform.

user_needs.description: What is the name of the shared Slack channel for operational communication?
